caption:
Microsoft Security Model isn't just another fine-tuned LLM.

Here's what actually happens in automated security orchestration:

1. Security Logs — Raw telemetry from endpoints, cloud infrastructure, and networks stream directly into the system.
2. Copilot Model — The domain-specific model analyzes signal correlations and generates targeted remediation plans.
3. Auto Defense — Automated scripts execute threat containment actions and return execution feedback.

Why it matters: General-purpose LLMs struggle with security context and precise tool execution, while dedicated domain models minimize false positives.

No magic — just specialized training on domain telemetry.
